title: Maine Lottery winner record (data/winners/winners.jsonl, one object per line)

winner_key.description: sha256 prefix of the normalized (names, town, game, prize, retailer) tuple — the dedup identity across captures (the page publishes no dates).

names.description: Winner name(s); more than one for split claims.

town.description: Winner's stated hometown; null when the page omits it.

prize.description: Prize dollars; null when the entry states no amount.

game.description: Game name as printed; null when the entry names none.

game_type.description: Conservative classification: 'draw' only for the site's own draw-game names; 'instant' only when the entry says so.

retailer_town.description: Town where the winning ticket was SOLD — the location-trend signal of record (winner residence is secondary).

first_seen.description: Earliest capture date on which this entry was observable. NOT a win/claim date — the page publishes none.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the raw capture bytes this record was parsed from.
